create_event_stream_handler: create an EventStreamHandler instance with an EventBus and a mapping of named event stream generators
connect_event_streams: connect the EventStreamHandler to start streaming all registered event generators to the event bus as async tasks
disconnect_event_streams: disconnect the EventStreamHandler to cancel all active stream tasks and clear the task registry
start_event_stream_internal: start a single named event stream that iterates an async generator, annotates events with stream metadata, and publishes each to the bus
review_event_stream_handler: review the EventStreamHandler class for correct async task lifecycle management including connect, disconnect, and cancellation handling
